Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_063389.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: autovcoder_063389.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_063389 (
    input  wire A1_S0,
    input  wire A1_S1,
    input  wire A2_S0,
    input  wire A2_S1,
    output wire Z_S0,
    output wire Z_S1
);
  wire X1, X2, Y1, Y2;
  wire X1_AN_Y1, X1_OR_Y2;
  wire X2_OR_Y1, X2_AN_Y2;

  assign X1 = A1_S0;
  assign X2 = A1_S1;
  assign Y1 = A2_S0;
  assign Y2 = A2_S1;

  // z1 = (x1 & y1) xor (x1 | y2)
  AN2D0 cmo_and0 (
      .A1(X1),
      .A2(Y1),
      .Z (X1_AN_Y1)
  );
  OR2D0 cmo_or0 (
      .A1(X1),
      .A2(Y2),
      .Z (X1_OR_Y2)
  );
  XOR2D0 cmo_xor0 (
      .A1(X1_AN_Y1),
      .A2(X1_OR_Y2),
      .Z (Z_S0)
  );

  // z2 = (x2 | y1) xor (x2 & y2)
  OR2D0 cmo_or1 (
      .A1(X2),
      .A2(Y1),
      .Z (X2_OR_Y1)
  );
  AN2D0 cmo_and1 (
      .A1(X2),
      .A2(Y2),
      .Z (X2_AN_Y2)
  );
  XOR2D0 cmo_xor1 (
      .A1(X2_OR_Y1),
      .A2(X2_AN_Y2),
      .Z (Z_S1)
  );
endmodule
